title: Doubtfully
summary: DOUBTFULLY, adverb 1. In a doubtful manner; dubiously. 2. With doubt; irresolutely. 3. Ambiguously; with uncertainty of meaning. Nor did the goddess doubtfully declare. 4. In a state of dread.
